items.prompt_summary: Hero stunned after charge hit: warm amber daze ring over head with orbiting leaves and bark-chip stars, torn-turf charge trail to boar
Wendigo 360 sweep: full-circle ivory/amber triple claw ring, dust ring, leaves and clods blown outward; red telegraph/bar removed
Howl variant A: dark red-brown thorn roots ring 2-5.5 m with glowing amber sap veins and fissures, big soil burst, dust wall
Howl variant B: thicker clustered spikes with honey-gold sap tips, huge radial clod/pebble explosion, tan dust ring, calm bright centre
Howl variant C: crisp readable ring, golden sap rim on the inner safe edge, near-black spikes bleeding amber sap, leaves in calm centre
Roots emerging, eruption instant: thick gnarled roots burst from cracked soil and spiral around hero's legs, soil/pebbles/dust thrown up
Roots hold: thick roots coiled tight around shins, tips dug back in, tilted turf plates, radial cracks, falling clods (one snarer drifted closer to hero)
Rotten fruit splat instant: burst fruit, acid-green crown splash frozen mid-air, puddle starting, grass darkening, first vapour
Puddle alive a second later: spread murky acid-green pool, bubbles and ripples, heavy green vapour, wilting brown grass, cracked dry crust at edge
